dimension_description: Dynamic viscosity measures how strongly a fluid resists being sheared or made to flow. Some entries are ordinary room-temperature liquids, others are effective viscosities for materials like glacier ice or the mantle that only flow over long timescales. Because viscosity changes strongly with temperature and composition, qualifiers matter here more than they do for many other scales.
